item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 15/May/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will bring slightly cooler weather to Guangdong tomorrow. Under the influence of a dry continental airstream, the weather will improve over southern China midweek this week. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week.
